Name: MMOSkillStationsPack
Description: MMO Skill Tree - interactive work stations. Ships the Sawmill: press use to saw logs into planks in a diegetic third-person work loop, earning passive Woodcutting + Crafting XP, tool-power-scaled, with luck-tiered bonus loot. Adds the station content, the in-world block, and the sawing loop's flavor assets. The station ENGINE ships in the standalone RPG Stations mod; the MMO Skill Tree bridge turns the loop into skill XP + luck. Both are hard dependencies; stations are dormant without this pack.
